checks.note: The only Anthropic calls are the agent loop (loop.ts) and the classifier (classifier.ts). Both models are in the manifest. The metadata scanner is regex-based, the eligibility peer is a signed-attestation API, and there are no embedding, rerank or moderation calls.

CLASSIFIER_MODEL is the pinned snapshot claude-haiku-4-5-20251001 in config.ts:50, with no env override or alias. The ID hashes the model, prompt and config. The manifest and budgets.yaml carry the same pinned ID.
The record is written before the route branch, so failures and staff routes are logged too. The detail carries classifierId, requestedModel and servedModel.

The catch for timeout or API error, the model mismatch, the parse failure and low confidence all return route staff. The only path to the agent is a valid, confident, non-urgent label. The classifier is called once, from loop.ts.

note: Every helper-model check holds: the only helper is the pinned intent classifier, it is in the inventory, it is audited on every branch, and every failure path routes to staff.
